neighbours.label: the token ' better' (any case) or the piece ' best' (also inside 'bestow'): the comparative/superlative better/best
fire: After the software update, the battery life is noticeably better than before.
My grandmother always said a good book is better company than a bad friend.
The new striker is the best signing the club has made in a decade.
You are better off keeping your savings in a high-interest account.
The chef claims this olive oil is better than anything from the region.
For a small apartment, a sofa bed is the best use of the limited space.
He speaks French better than anyone else in the office.
The sequel is better than the original in almost every respect.
quiet: The older model is good enough for everyday tasks and costs less.
The weather turned worse during the afternoon hike in the hills.
An inferior alloy was used to keep the production costs down.
The superior candidate withdrew before the final vote took place.
It is preferable to book the morning flight to avoid the rush.
We need more volunteers to staff the booth at the festival.
Less sugar makes the sauce taste closer to the original recipe.
I would rather read the paperback than wait for the hardcover.
